home_title: Explore your Lichess and Chess.com games
home_intro: Link your Lichess account, your Chess.com account or both, even with different usernames, to gather your stats in one place.

footer_independent: Independent project, not affiliated with Lichess or Chess.com.
legal_publisher_body: ChessMe is a personal, non-commercial project. As allowed by French law for non-professional publishers (LCEN, art. 6), the publisher's identity has been provided to the host.
legal_contact: Contact: open an issue on the project's GitHub repository.
legal_privacy_intro: ChessMe has no account, no server-side database, no cookies, no analytics and no ads. Nothing you search is sent to us.
legal_privacy_local_app: the app's files, so it works offline once installed.
legal_privacy_thirdparty_body: Your browser fetches public data directly from Lichess (lichess.org) and Chess.com (api.chess.com, and images.chesscomfiles.com for avatars). Those services see your IP address, as with any website, under their own privacy policies.
legal_privacy_host_logs: The host may keep technical access logs (IP address, pages requested) to run and secure the service.
legal_privacy_public_data: Profiles and games shown come from the public APIs of Lichess and Chess.com. They are fetched on demand and not stored by us.
legal_clear_body: Removes your language choice, recent searches, analysis settings and training options from this browser.
legal_license_body: ChessMe is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0: you may use, study, modify and share it under the same license.
legal_credits_board: board and chess rules by Lichess, GPL-3.0
legal_credits_pieces: pieces by Colin M.L. Burnett, GPL-2.0-or-later
legal_credits_data: Data: Lichess API and Chess.com Published-Data API.
legal_trademarks: Lichess and Chess.com are trademarks of their respective owners. ChessMe is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by them.
legal_warranty: Provided as is, without warranty, as stated by the license.
chesscom_data_delay: Chess.com updates this data at most every 12 to 24 hours: your latest games may not show up yet.
